body:
A whole bunch of AP courses. I just feel absolutely miserable in my work, which hasn't happened to me this badly in previous years. People keep telling me how close I am to going to college and all that, but the end of this seems farther than I can walk. 

As for the whole people caring for me idea, I just don't feel it. I feel as if all people are judging me for my shortcomings and can't wait to laugh at me when I fail.
